jobs.title: [Part-time] - Pengajar Bahasa Inggris - Tanjung Balai Karimun
English Teacher Eye Level Subang Kertawigenda
jobs.description: Requirements: Candidates with at least D3/S1 in Education, Linguistic/English, or equivalent. Fresh graduates and last year students are welcome to apply. Required skill(s): Teaching English, time management, and communication. Fluent in English; written and spoken. Love teaching and being able to teach English to children aged 4-15 years old. Familiar with children and teens. Has the initiative to introduce the Eye Level program. Honest, disciplined, committed, communicative, attractive, creative, hard-worker, and tech-savvy. Maintaining an neat yet professional look is a plus. Willing to work onsite. Live around Subang is preferred. General Responsibilities: Teaching English to children aged 4-15 years old. Provide quality academic coaching in a small group setting, according to Eye Level philosophy, methods, curriculum, and individual progress plan. Communicate effectively and professionally with students, parents, and staff. Motivate and encourage students. Grading and maintaining progress reports for each student. Performs administrative activities if needed. Notify the Center Director of any problems or concerns.

company_info.description: PT. Daekyo Indonesia, melalui brand Eye Level, telah hadir di Indonesia sejak tahun 2007 untuk memberikan pendidikan nonformal berkualitas kepada anak-anak usia 4-15 tahun.

jobs.title: AI Trainer - Video Annotation
jobs.description: AI Trainer - Video Annotation Remote | Independent Contractor Prove your skills. Get certified. Robotics AI is advancing rapidly, and high-quality video data helps intelligent systems better understand the world around them. We are inviting detail-oriented professionals to complete our certification process for potential robotics AI projects. ▌ What you will do As part of the certification process, you will demonstrate your ability to: Annotate short video clips by identifying objects, actions and events. Evaluate video quality, relevance and accuracy against established guidelines. Assess the clarity and plausibility of movements. Apply instructions consistently and identify potential quality issues. ▌ What you bring Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking. Strong written English and the ability to follow detailed instructions independently. A commitment to accuracy and consistency. No previous AI or robotics experience required. ▌ What the work looks like You may review short videos and be asked to tag objects or actions, rate video clarity or camera angles on a 1 to 10 scale, or assess whether movements are clearly visible and plausible. Please note: We currently have three projects open, and completing the certification process will allow us to evaluate which project may be the best fit for you.
